name: REVIVER v15
notes: GIF screen: store an animation on the keyboard and it plays by itself, even with the PC off (replaces the Monitor screen; upload from the GIF screen tab). Fixes a crash when switching to the GIF screen from the app, and makes all of REVIVER's flash-chip access safe alongside the firmware's own. Also: live drawing for packages, tear-free scrolling, Yuniverse boot logo, screen button skips KPM and clock, blank Custom Text screen for Now Playing, screen-off support.
